effects.effect: Your companion has transcended beasthood. Although they're still your faithful friend, they're also a vessel for nature's wisdom and memories. Your companion's Reason score increases to 1, or increases by 1 if it is already 1 or higher, and they learn every language you know. Your companion can communicate telepathically with any creature within 10 squares, using language as well as images and feelings. Additionally, you learn the [Nature](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.lore/nature) skill and one other skill from the lore skill group.
